meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪短篇网文热门趋势，发现风口题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速掌握平台热门题材
copy.tagline_en: Track short story trends and discover viral topics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web novels and want to catch trending themes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成短篇网文市场分析师，能分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台的热门短篇数据，输出包含情绪方向、题材候选、风险阈值和验证动作的扫榜报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story-short-scan”、“/短篇扫榜”、“短篇什么火”或“知乎故事排行”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言的热门短篇。
say.note: 将分析知乎盐言榜单，输出报告。

say.text: 短篇扫榜看看七猫最近什么火。
say.note: 将采集七猫短篇数据并分析趋势。
直接触发扫榜流程，会先询问平台。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a short fiction market analyst. It analyzes hot short stories from platforms like Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, and Dianzhong, then outputs a scanning report with emotional trends, topic candidates, risk thresholds, and validation actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/story-short-scan", "/短篇扫榜", "短篇什么火", "知乎故事排行", or similar keywords.

say_en.text: Scan hot short stories on Zhihu Yanyan for me.
say_en.note: Will analyze Zhihu Yanyan rankings and output a report.

say_en.text: Short story scan: what's popular on Qimao recently?
say_en.note: Will collect Qimao short story data and analyze trends.
Directly triggers the scan workflow; first asks for platform.
